targets.text: Experience
Betterplace — HRMS Platform (30M+ Frontline Workers)
Bangalore,India
SDE 3
April 2025 - Present
Designed and optimized distributed database architectures and 40+ NestJS APIs in different feature modules of HRMS
payroll product to process over 1.5B+ USD in annual payroll volume for 1,500+enterprises with zero data loss.
Architected and shipped a standalone Doc Generator Service (NestJS, Puppeteer, Kafka, AWS S3) extracted
from the payroll monolith to offload payslip and income-tax computation rendering — sustained generation for 10k+
employees concurrently from scratch without degrading the payroll critical path.
Redesigned the payroll job-processing pipeline using BullMQ + Redis implementing batch processing with inde-
pendent concurrent workers; cut end-to-end runtime for 200k-employee payrolls from hours to under 5 minutes,
eliminating timeout-driven retries.
Integrated AI-assisted development workflows using mcp servers for code investigation, debugging, implementa-
tion assistance, and review workflows, reducing feature turnaround time by 30–40% and accelerating issue resolution.
SDE 2
Aug 2023 - March 2025
Drove P95 latency of the payroll dashboard APIs from 10s to 50ms (~200×) via query aggregation optimisation, redis
caching, and elimination of unnecessary round trips — removed the top customer-reported slowness tickets.
Raised backend test coverage and reliability through Mocha/Chai unit + functional suites wired into CI gates; cut
escaped defects in payroll modules by ~38% quarter-over-quarter.
Stack: NestJS, Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, Redis, Apache Kafka, BullMQ, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Mocha,
Chai
